bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.first: Bought off a goblin for less than it's worth. Most pages are blank. Fill them in the hard way.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.unknown: A green thumbprint, and nothing else.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.0: Small, quick, and never alone. Where there's one, look behind you.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.1: They break when the big ones fall. Take the loudest first.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.2: They'll sell their own mothers. They'll certainly sell their king.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.slinger.0: A pouch of stones and a good arm. Keep your head down.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.slinger.1: Close the distance and they've nothing.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.slinger.2: They collect the stones afterwards. Every one.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.goblin_king.0: Fat on what the others bring him. He's never far from his hoard.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.goblin_king.1: He hits harder than he looks. Don't let the crown fool you.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.goblin_king.2: Every map in the tribe points back to him.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.grunt.0: All shoulders. They throw what they carry.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.grunt.1: Hurt them and they get angrier, not slower.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.grunt.2: Hired out to goblins, sometimes. They hate it.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.ranger.0: They watch from the trees before anyone else knows you're there.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.ranger.1: Light armour. Don't trade shots, rush them.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.ranger.2: They're the ones who follow trails. Blood especially.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.shaman.0: Bones and smoke. The others fight harder near one.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.shaman.1: Fragile. Reach it and it's over quickly.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.shaman.2: They talk to something. It doesn't always answer.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.warchief.0: The biggest of them, with the most scars to show for it.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.warchief.1: When he roars, step back. When he slams, step aside.
bestiary.jaymoskingdoms.warchief.2: The goblins have a king. The orcs want one.
